mapper.select: /* NoticeMapper.selectNoticeDetail - 공지사항 상세조회 */ SELECT p.pst_id AS pstId, p.bbs_id AS bbsId, p.ttl AS ttl, p.pst_cn AS pstCn, COALESCE(p.ntc_yn,'N') AS ntcYn, COALESCE(p.top_std_yn,'N') AS topStdYn, COALESCE(p.view_use_yn,'N') AS viewUseYn, p.bbs_st_ymd AS bbsStYmd, p.bbs_st_tm AS bbsStTm, p.bbs_ed_ymd AS bbsEdYmd, p.bbs_ed_tm AS bbsEdTm, to_CHAR(p.bbs_st_ymd::DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')|| ' '|| TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(p.bbs_st_tm, 'HH24MISS'), 'HH24:MI') AS bbsStDt, to_CHAR(p.bbs_ed_ymd::DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD')|| ' '|| TO_CHAR(TO_TIMESTAMP(p.bbs_ed_tm, 'HH24MISS'), 'HH24:MI') AS bbsEdDt, p.atch_file_group_id AS atchFileGroupId, p.inq_cnt AS inqCnt, p.rgtr_id AS regId, u.usr_nm AS regNm, TO_CHAR(p.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regDt FROM cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst p LEFT JOIN cdm_own.usr u ON p.rgtr_id = u.usr_id WHERE p.bbs_id = 'NOTICE' AND p.pst_id = #{pstId}
mapper.insert:
/* NoticeMapper.insertNotice - 공지사항 등록 */ INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst ( pst_id, bbs_id, ttl, pst_cn, top_std_yn, use_yn, view_use_yn, bbs_st_ymd, bbs_st_tm, bbs_ed_ymd, bbs_ed_tm, atch_file_group_id, inq_cnt, rgtr_id, reg_dt ) VALUES ( #{pstId}, #{bbsId}, #{ttl}, #{pstCn}, COALESCE(#{topStdYn}, 'N'),
'Y', COALESCE(#{viewUseYn}, 'N'), #{bbsStYmd}, COALESCE(#{bbsStTm}, '000000'), #{bbsEdYmd}, COALESCE(#{bbsEdTm}, '235959'), #{atchFileGroupId}, 0, #{gdsUserId}, NOW() )
mapper.update: /* NoticeMapper.updateNotice - 공지사항 수정 */ UPDATE cdm_own.cmpt_bbs_pst SET ttl = #{ttl}, pst_cn = #{pstCn}, view_use_yn = COALESCE(#{viewUseYn}, 'N'), top_std_yn = COALESCE(#{topStdYn}, 'N'), bbs_st_ymd = #{bbsStYmd}, bbs_st_tm = COALESCE(#{bbsStTm}, '000000'), bbs_ed_ymd = #{bbsEdYmd}, bbs_ed_tm = COALESCE(#{bbsEdTm}, '235959'), atch_file_group_id = #{atchFileGroupId}, mdfr_id = #{gdsUserId}, mdfcn_dt = NOW() WHERE bbs_id = 'NOTICE' AND pst_id = #{pstId}
